character_idle.limits: Idle motion covers all seven items. OPTIONS and DRAGON SUMMONING use host trigonometry. Emphasis remains pending; CUSTOMIZE secondary clock initialization is caller-supplied.

item_character_animation.limits: Common whole-character entry/exit only. Per-part idle and common emphasis are provided by separate recovered modules; native selection scheduling is not reproduced.

arrow_baselines.limits: Static base positions; bob displacement is zero in the preview. Conditional history flags default to zero.

item_label_animation.limits: Entry/active/exit subset only. Common emphasis is provided by item_emphasis; outer selection scheduling and GPU compositing are not reproduced.

shared_small_animation.limits: Recovered small-component curves and lifecycle; host float32, no textures or final compositing.

shared_banner.limits: Banner geometry and host-float32 curves only; textures, outer activation and final compositing are not reproduced.

shared_scheduler.limits: Shared scheduler only. Caller supplies banner/small animation updates; outer menu activation, textures and compositing remain unresolved.

tile_companion_owner.limits: Inner tile/companion owner only. Outer menu activation/exit, wall-clock timing and draw visibility are not inferred.

native_rng.limits: Algorithm is recovered; context state and calls by other game systems are runtime inputs, not inferred.

shared_companions.limits: Reset positions use startup defaults; captured runtime writes and the global RNG state/call ordering are not inferred.

tile_scroll_kernel.limits: This exporter isolates tile phase arithmetic. Companion timer and inner owner lifecycle are separate modules; full outer menu scheduling is not reproduced.

strip_rotation_kernels.limits: Only strip command rotations 0 and float32 pi/2 are supported. Host float32 VU approximation, not hardware emulation.
